source_evidence: Publisher captions plus an existing bounded sampled-still review; no continuous-video/audio review claimed. Source discrepancy between L5 printed heart-failure slide and cardiac-arrest captions is preserved.
prose_status: Accepted manuscript after two independent full scientific/editorial reviews, targeted repairs and specified production checks.
code_validation: Executed successfully: conservation grid, finite-difference ODE residual, Nernst equilibrium, zero-conductance limit and invalid-input checks passed. Program reproduces printed synthetic values.

figures.role: Controlled exact neutral-solute diffusion with conductance adjustment and a separate voltage-dependent K energy check; fixed volumes and synthetic parameters.
Controlled Na/K pump phase sequence, three Na out/two K in, with a distinct sodium-dependent symporter. Shapes and presentation timings are schematic.
Controlled one-state negative-feedback trace and sensor/controller/effector display from one shared state, gain adjustment, no-feedback comparison and nonzero steady error.
Inline original membrane sectional reconstruction; no atomic geometry, physical scale or photorealism claim.
Original causal failure-mode comparison; no accepted anatomical render claimed.

limitations: Diffusion assumes closed, well-mixed fixed volumes without voltage, water movement or reaction; energy equations use ideal activities and fixed voltage.
The proportional-feedback model excludes delay, saturation and adaptation; it is not a glucose or blood-pressure calibration.
All numerical trajectories and phase representations are synthetic teaching constructions; no patient fitting or measured protein kinetics is claimed.
Scranton et al. 2025 mouse/myocyte evidence is a bounded research extension, not a demonstrated human therapy.
Some Bookshelf/IUPHAR sources were accessible only as indexed excerpts, and the CFTR original study at indexed-abstract depth; exact source access limits remain in the reader.
Source-frame inspection is bounded sampling, not continuous video/audio. Private browser PDF proofs include an installed extension overlay and are not public PDF deliverables.
coverage_basis: Core source-topic spans and reasoned exclusions checked in the two independent full reviews; evidence is publisher captions plus bounded sampled-still audits, not continuous audio/video inspection.

production_validation.scope: Historical actual production evidence plus current scientific-artifact identity and a separate bounded current reader reinspection.
